methodology.timed_region: repeated invocation, output consumption and mismatch checks; process startup, parsing, projection and native compilation excluded
methodology.object_c_lifetime: fresh context, all allocation blocks and destruction included for every invocation; whole-entry lifetime arena, no GC
methodology.direct_c_lifetime: fresh context construction and destruction included for every invocation; source/global initialization is part of pe_run
methodology.original_node_fresh_module: factory source compiled once outside timing; each timed invocation creates fresh guest functions/prototypes/globals and then executes main, without reparsing
methodology.js_lifetime: source loaded once per process; calls allocate normal JS objects and include any GC triggered during the timed batch
methodology.original_repeat_adapter: unchanged COUNT=1000 workload, input selects number of independent runs
methodology.runtime_count_adapter: input controls actual IdleTask scheduling countdown; returned queue and hold counts consumed
